title.narrative: Improving Water, Sanitation and Hygiene in Health and Education Facilities in Pendembu Koh, Kailahun

description.narrative:
This project, in Pendembu Koh, Kailahun District, Sierra Leone, will contribute to achieving improved WASH, Health and Education in the target area. As well as complementing the early recovery plan of the Government from the Ebola Virus Disease response crisis.
At present, The Sisters of the Congregation of the Handmaids of the Holy Child Jesus is supporting the Pendembu community in the area of health, education, psychosocial counselling and livelihoods. The health facility and the boarding facility for teenage girls that is being supported by the Sisters of the Congregation of the Handmaids of the Holy Child Jesus does not have improved water WASH facilities. Non-governmental actors have implemented WASH projects in the community, however, this has been done without due consideration to the issues of sustainability and community ownership followed by Limited capacity within the Ministry of Health and Sanitation.
This project will therefore help improve the education of girls/children in the intervention community. This will further improve the knowledge/attitudes and practices of the targeted groups in hygiene and sanitation, including wider hand-washing campaigns.
